Count supported membership against the union of all implemented physical identities, including reprints owned by another set; retain banned/unresolved members in denominators as unsupported.
Keep full-set acceptance separate from admission. Preserve accepted ECL/TMT coverage even though the current checkout omits those completed branch merges.
